asked.item: Schedule a campaign about 11 months ahead

verdict.reason: The scheduling horizon sentences state the 9-month limit on every plan, the error past it, and the suggested workaround.

steps.text: The furthest date in the future you can schedule a post for is 9 months on every plan.
If you try to schedule a post past 9 months, Blotato returns an error.
Pick a time within the 9-month window or break longer campaigns into shorter batches.
